Our services

Everything is done by hand, with breaks whenever your dog needs one.

01

Full groom

Bath, blow-dry, haircut, nails and ears, finished the way you like.

02

03

Puppy introduction

A short first visit so your puppy meets the dryer, the table and us without any pressure.

About Fernbrook

Fernbrook started in a converted garden room in 2019 after years of working in busy salons.

Many of our regulars came to us because other groomers found them too anxious. They now trot in happily.

  • Qualified and insured groomer
  • Quiet, low-noise dryers
  • Collection when your dog is ready
